hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Single-LP AMM hook implementing a custom bonding curve backed by Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes via its custom curve, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to fully bypass Uniswap v4's CLAMM math. Prevents standard LP positions and donations via revert-only beforeAddLiquidity and beforeDonate.
